description: Caster group with heavy debuffs: Elf Priest, Bard, Neph Wizard, Neph Sin, Neph Channeler, Elf Druid.
name: High Resist Caster
strategy:
Depends on whether we have a bard.
With a bard: prestun twice (and immune), rush in, target 1 priest and 1 DPS. Most DPS should go on the enemy DPS, not the priest (prioritize DPS that is not a Neph mage).
Without a bard: go in slowly, calling targets and switching them by the debuffs' downtime (once they're up, change).
Debuff → debuff → hit → Shadowmantle, so they can't strip all the debuffs before the target dies.
